Responsibility: Construct 1D curvilinear flowline grid and interpolate BedMachine/Bedmap3 topography
Governing_Equation: H_init = s_init - z_b - FAC_init; x_i = i * Delta x
Numerical_Method: 1D linear/cubic spline interpolation from project raster polygons
Failure_Conditions: Negative ice thickness (H < 0), zero channel width (W <= 0), non-monotonic grid

Responsibility: Isolate solid ice-equivalent thickness H from geometric firn thickness and calculate surface elevation
Governing_Equation: H_geom(x, t) = H(x, t) + FAC(x, t); s(x, t) = z_b(x) + H_geom(x, t)
Failure_Conditions: FAC < 0 m, FAC > 25 m, s < z_b (unphysical surface below bedrock)

Responsibility: Convert RACMO2.3p2 water-equivalent SMB into solid-ice thickness accumulation rate and mass flux density
Primary_Inputs: a_dot_we (RACMO net SMB); rho_water (1000 kg m^-3); rho_i (917 kg m^-3)
Input_Units: m w.e. yr^-1; kg m^-3; kg m^-3
Output_Units: m ice-eq yr^-1 (or m s^-1); kg m^-2 s^-1
Governing_Equation: a_dot_i = (rho_water / rho_i) * a_dot_we = 1.0905125 * a_dot_we; a_dot_s = rho_i * a_dot_i
Numerical_Method: Staged scalar scaling on cell centers
Failure_Conditions: Double-conversion detected, unphysical extreme accumulation (|a_dot_we| > 10 m w.e./yr)

Responsibility: Calculate temperature-dependent ice softness A(T) and regularized depth-averaged effective viscosity
Primary_Inputs: du/dx (strain rate); T_ice (temperature); A_ref; n (Glen exponent 3); eps_dot_0
Input_Units: s^-1; deg C; Pa^-n s^-1; dimensionless; s^-1
Failure_Conditions: nu_bar <= 0 Pa s, nu_bar > 1e16 Pa s (viscosity explosion), NaN generated

Responsibility: Compute regularized basal friction traction and linearized coefficient for Weertman sliding
Primary_Inputs: u (face velocity); C_bed; m (sliding exponent 1/3); u_reg (1e-4 m/yr)
Input_Units: m s^-1; Pa (m/s)^-m; dimensionless; m s^-1
Output_Units: Pa s m^-1 (N s m^-3); Pa (N m^-2)
Governing_Equation: beta_b_reg = C_bed * (u^2 + u_reg^2)^((m-1)/2); tau_b_reg = beta_b_reg * u
Numerical_Method: Smooth velocity regularization at staggered cell faces
Failure_Conditions: beta_b_reg <= 0, division by zero at u=0, sign(tau_b) != sign(u)

Responsibility: Compute regularized lateral valley drag traction and resistance force per unit length
Primary_Inputs: u_bar (mean velocity); A(T); W (channel width); n (3); u_reg (1e-4 m/yr)
Input_Units: m s^-1; Pa^-3 s^-1; m; dimensionless; m s^-1
Output_Units: Pa s m^-1; Pa; N m^-1
Governing_Equation: tau_wall = [(5 * u_bar)/(A * W)]^(1/n); beta_wall_reg = [5/(A * W)]^(1/n) * (u^2 + u_reg^2)^((1-n)/(2n)); F_lat = 2 * H * tau_wall
Numerical_Method: Reduced-order scalar pure-shear evaluation at vertical rock walls
Failure_Conditions: beta_wall <= 0, F_lat < 0 for u > 0, unphysical pinning when W >> H

Responsibility: Calculate unbuttressed and buttressed solid ice discharge flux and Dirichlet face velocity
Primary_Inputs: h_GL (flotation thickness); C_bed; A; theta_buttress; omega_b; mu
Input_Units: m; Pa (m/s)^-m; Pa^-3 s^-1; dimensionless; dimensionless; dimensionless
Primary_Outputs: q_GL (discharge per unit width); u_GL (boundary face velocity); Q_GL (total volumetric discharge)
Governing_Equation: q_unbutt = [(rho_i g (1 - rho_i/rho_w))/(4^n A)]^(1/(m+1)) * C_bed^(-1/(m+1)) * h_GL^((m+n+3)/(m+1)); q_GL = q_unbutt * [1 - omega_b * theta]^mu; u_GL = q_GL / h_GL
Numerical_Method: Asymptotic matched boundary layer analytical formulation
Failure_Conditions: q_GL < 0, u_GL < 0, h_GL <= 0 (bedrock above sea level), surge ratio > 300x

Responsibility: Track continuous sub-grid grounding-line coordinate and calculate terminal cell friction fraction
Primary_Inputs: H (thickness); z_b (bedrock); rho_w (1028); rho_i (917); Delta x
Input_Units: m; m; kg m^-3; kg m^-3; m
Primary_Outputs: x_GL (continuous GL position); k_GL (terminal cell index); lambda_GL (grounded fraction)
Governing_Equation: Delta z_flot(x) = H(x) + (rho_w / rho_i) * z_b(x); x_GL = x_k + Delta x * (Delta z_k / (Delta z_k - Delta z_{k+1})); lambda_GL = (x_GL - x_{k-1/2}) / Delta x
Numerical_Method: Continuous zero-crossing linear flotation root finder
Failure_Conditions: lambda_GL < 0 or > 1, root bracket failure, grounding line jumps > 2 cells in one step

Responsibility: Assemble and solve the non-linear 1D SSA momentum equation on staggered grid using Picard iteration
Primary_Inputs: H; W; z_b; s; u_old; C_bed; A; u_GL; Delta x; omega_relax; tol; max_iter
Input_Units: m; m; m; m; m s^-1; Pa (m/s)^-m; Pa^-3 s^-1; m s^-1; m; dimensionless; dimensionless; integer
Governing_Equation: - A_{i+1/2} u_{i-1/2} + B_{i+1/2} u_{i+1/2} - C_{i+1/2} u_{i+3/2} = F_{i+1/2}; Thomas Algorithm (TDMA) on Form 1 [N]
Numerical_Method: Picard iteration with under-relaxation (omega=0.50-0.60) and Thomas algorithm
Failure_Conditions: Picard divergence (iter > 25), zero pivot in Thomas algorithm, NaN in velocity field

Responsibility: Step ice thickness forward in time using finite-volume mass conservation with adaptive CFL time stepping
Primary_Inputs: H_old; u_face; W; a_dot_i; Delta x; C_CFL; Delta t_max; Delta t_min
Input_Units: m; m s^-1; m; m s^-1; m; dimensionless; yr; yr
Governing_Equation: del(W H)/del t + del(W H u)/del x = W a_dot_i; Delta t <= C_CFL * Delta x / max(|u|)
Numerical_Method: First-order upwind donor-cell finite volume with adaptive Courant controller
Failure_Conditions: Negative thickness H < 0, CFL violation (CFL > 0.50), Delta t < Delta t_min

Responsibility: Compute total grounded volume and verify discrete vs continuous mass conservation without double-counting
Primary_Inputs: H; W; Delta x; x_GL; lambda_GL; a_dot_i; q_GL; v_GL; rho_i
Input_Units: m; m; m; m; dimensionless; m s^-1; m^2 s^-1; m s^-1; kg m^-3
Output_Units: m^3; kg; kg s^-1 (or Gt/yr); dimensionless in [-1, 1]
Governing_Equation: V_g = sum_{i=1}^{k-1} W_i H_i Delta x + lambda_GL W_k H_k Delta x; dM_g/dt = SMB_g - D_GL - M_unground
Numerical_Method: Direct discrete Eulerian volume summation + Reynolds Transport analytical audit
Failure_Conditions: Mass conservation relative residual > 1e-7, grounded volume increases while SMB < D

Responsibility: Aggregate flowline basin results into Domain A volume trajectories and format scientific netCDF/CSV
Primary_Inputs: Delta V_{Hp-I}(t), Delta V_{I-Ipp}(t), Delta V_{Ipp-J}(t)
Governing_Equation: Delta V_{Domain A}(t) = Delta V_{Hp-I}(t) + Delta V_{I-Ipp}(t) + Delta V_{Ipp-J}(t)
Failure_Conditions: Basin sum discrepancy != 0 (drift > 1e-12 km^3), missing time steps, corrupted netCDF
